chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdullah (عليه السلام), concerning the saying of Allah, Majestic and Mighty.
He said: “By the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام).”
I shall fulfill for you with Paradise.

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin; title of Imam Ali (عليه السلام)
key_terms.أُوفِ: I shall fulfill; Allah’s completion of His promise
key_terms.بِعَهْدِي: My covenant; the divine covenant mentioned in the verse
key_terms.بِوَلَايَةِ: by the wilayah; referring here to loyal adherence to divinely appointed authority

ai.seo_question: How is Allah’s covenant in this verse explained in relation to the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This narration presents the phrase “And fulfill My covenant” as referring to the wilayah of Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام). It then explains the divine promise “I shall fulfill your covenant” as Allah granting Paradise in return. The report thus links covenantal faithfulness, wilayah, and the promise of the afterlife.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Majestic and Mighty
[2:40] and be faithful to (your) Covenant with Me.
He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘By the Wilayah of Amir Al-Momineen<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>
I will Fulfill (My) Covenant with you.
I<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> shall Fulfill for you with the Paradise’.
